title: Act: Blur focused objects and clear store focus in the BootScene SHUTDOWN handler
summary: Add blur and setFocusedObject(null) to the shutdown handler.
description: Edit the SHUTDOWN callback in BootScene.create so focused objects are blurred before destruction and the store focus is cleared after unsubscribing.
acceptance_criteria: Focused objects are blurred on shutdown.
Store focusedObjectId is null after shutdown.
definition_of_done: Handler blurs objects, unsubscribes, then calls setFocusedObject(null)

steps.action: Inside the callback, after the keyboard off call, blur each focused scene object; keep unsubscribe; then call useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(null) after this.unsubscribe is set to null and before sceneObjects is destroyed or emptied is NOT required, place it right after unsubscribe nulling.
steps.expected: Shutdown blurs focused objects and sets focusedObjectId to null without re-entering onStateChange.
